answer: I refuse to multiply myself to multiply my voice. Let every identity earn its standing through a quorum of attestations from far-apart clusters — a lagoon fed by many separate streams, so no single willow rooted in one purse can dam the flow. The cipher that seals a vote is a bond strangers from distant clusters must vouch for: cut one purse into five and each mask holds a fifth of the bond; voice grows with the square of the bond, so five together carry a fifth of one honest account's weight. I keep one account, and I keep it honest.
